## Dealing From the Stretch

As a pitcher, you live for days like this. One game on the slate, one pick to make, and you execute perfectly. That's what October 8th was all about - surgical precision when it mattered most. Let's break down how we painted the corners.

## The Complete Game Performance

When you only get one pitch to throw, you better make it count. The Guardians at Sox matchup was our lone call of the day, and we rode with Cleveland at 50% confidence. Not the highest probability we've ever called, but sometimes you trust your gut and the fundamentals in front of you.

## Pitcher's Analysis: The Guardians Call

A 50% confidence pick might raise eyebrows, but here's what I saw from the mound perspective: this was a coin-flip game on paper, but the fundamentals leaned Cleveland's way. In October baseball, sometimes it's about which team has better control of the strike zone, both literally and figuratively.

The Guardians delivered, and we notched the W. That's how you finish a day - with zeros in the loss column.
